Vietnam · 9–16 Nov · 7 nights · mid-range

Tunnels, peaks, karts and canyons

You clear Saigon airport at 11:00 on Monday and fly out of Saigon at 08:00 the next Monday. Củ Chi on day one, then north by plane and night train to Fansipan, a night out in Hà Nội, two days of adrenaline in Đà Lạt, and a last night in Saigon.

    Know before you go

    Weather in mid-November

    PlaceFeels like
    SaigonHot, 27–32°C. Dry season is starting.
    Hà NộiMild and dry, low to mid 20s°C. The best month of the year.
    SapaCool days, cold nights. The Fansipan summit can be near freezing.
    Đà LạtCool days. Nights around 15°C.

    Pack one proper warm layer for Sapa. You can buy cheap jackets in Sapa town.

    Changed or left out

    • Basket boat: dropped. The rides are in Hội An / Đà Nẵng, which is a third region and flood season in November.
    • Ninh Bình: cut. Its time went to Đà Lạt.
    • Go-kart: you get two kinds. A real 3-level electric kart track in Saigon, and the gravity "Luge Kart" downhill in Đà Lạt.
    • Zipline: covered twice, inside canyoning and on the 1,500 m Datanla line.

    Getting around

    • Install Grab. It works in all four places.
    • Travel light. You carry everything on the night train. Ask your Hà Nội hotel (Thursday night) to hold big bags from Tuesday.
    • Saigon domestic flights leave from T1 or the new T3 depending on airline. Check each ticket.
    • Hà Nội → Đà Lạt nonstop flights don't run every day. If Friday has none, connect in Saigon.

    Paperwork

    • Most passports, Indian included, need an e-visa. Apply only on the government portal, evisa.gov.vn, at least a week ahead.
    • Buy travel insurance that names canyoning and ziplining.

    Train Street: the authorities ban tours from bringing people onto the tracks. Sit inside a café when a train comes and never stand on the rails.
